Subject: Redwood vendor onboarding — invite & PO billing details

Hi Samir,

Welcome — excited to get NimbleFleet set up in our procurement system. Two quick asks to move the supplier onboarding forward this week: 

1) We sent a Coupa onboarding invite to accounts-payable@nimblefleet.com this morning (subject: "Redwood Supplier Onboarding: NimbleFleet Solutions"). Can you confirm whether your AP team received that link? If not, please check spam and let us know a preferred contact.

2) We noticed the billing address and VAT/Tax ID on your SOW draft differ from the address in your vendor profile. To avoid PO/Remittance errors, please confirm the correct remit-to address and whether Redwood should route POs to the US entity or the UK entity.

I've attached the SOW we have on file and a screenshot of the Coupa invitation for reference. If helpful, we can run a short screen-share to walk through registering.

Next steps: if you can confirm AP email + remit-to by EOD Fri (2026-10-16), we'll validate the account and issue the first test PO.

Thanks,
Monica
